description: Convert text to UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case, Sentence case, aLtErNaTiNg cAsE and iNVERSE cAsE instantly, then copy or download the result.

faqs.a: It lowercases everything, then capitalizes the first letter of the text and the first letter after every sentence-ending period, exclamation or question mark.
It flips the case of every letter: uppercase becomes lowercase and lowercase becomes uppercase.
No hard limit. Very large pastes may take a moment, but conversion runs entirely in your browser.
faqs.q: Is there a text size limit?

howto: Paste or type your text in the input box.
Click a case button to transform the text.
The result updates live as you type.
Use Copy or Download .txt to save the result.
title: Case Converter
